qaza.gender.title: Your gender
qaza.puberty.title: When did you reach puberty?
qaza.puberty_help.body: In the Hanafi school, if there were no signs of puberty, it begins at the completion of 15 lunar years — about 14 years and 7 months. Based on your birthdate, that is {date}.
qaza.prayer_start.title: When did you start praying regularly?
qaza.menstruation.title: Menstruation
qaza.menstruation.hint: Between 3 and 10 days. They are subtracted from prayer qada automatically. Fasting is never adjusted.
qaza.nifas.note: Post-natal bleeding (up to 40 days per childbirth) is also excused from prayer. Subtract those days yourself from the prefilled counts before saving. Ramadan fasts missed in that time must still be made up.
qaza.safar.title: Safar days
qaza.safar.days_label: How many of those days were you in safar?
qaza.safar.hint: In the Hanafi school, a traveler — a journey of about 90 km (3 days) or more, staying less than 15 days — shortens Zuhr, Asr and Isha to 2 rakahs. These days are subtracted from the main counts and kept as a separate safar count.
qaza.fasting_start.title: When did you start fasting Ramadan?
qaza.fasting_start.which: This year has two Ramadans. Which one did you start with?
qaza.result.title: Your estimated qaza
qaza.result.nifas_reminder: If you gave birth, subtract up to 40 days per childbirth from the prayer counts before saving.
qaza.result.disclaimer: This is an estimate based on the Umm al-Qura calendar; dates may differ by a day from local moon sighting. Make up your qaza consistently.
qaza.feedback.title: Found a mistake? Please tell us
qaza.feedback.thanks: Thank you! We'll take a look shortly.
